first_sweep_soft_layers.note: soft-softmax layers (tau=1, smoothness 0.05), held-out silhouette IoU measured with a 1-sample-per-pixel splat that left holes on enlarged frames (fixed later); numbers copied from the run log of build/sweep.sh, not re-run
first_sweep_soft_layers.rule: smallest K within 0.01 of the best -> K=8

soft_layers_K8_fixed_splat.verdict: rejected: the best numbers, but the layers were not layers (each point blended ~all 8 motions; per-layer affines rotated 40 deg and scaled 0.5); hinges meaningless (40-75 px disagreement)

crisp_layers_EM.note: adopted family: EM with a Potts prior, layer weights = blurred one-hot labels, hinge-consistency loss lam_h at the layer borders
